author: /root/hindi_translation

references.use: Honorific software register, technical key names, source logic/consistency; guidance considered critically rather than blanket authority.
Primary Hindi software usage of आरक्षित for reserved credit/capacity semantics.
Attests Hindi software loanword म्यूट/अनम्यूट; shared-key audio/chat distinction remains established from code.

accepted_context_decisions: Play and Play {slot0} are game-navigation/host-map actions, not audio playback; खेलें is correct there. Separate Play music/Play animation use चलाएँ correctly.
Building is an in-progress build/mood label at inspected callers, so निर्माण is correct; do not change it to इमारत indiscriminately.
AI library views is a LibraryNav heading, not a view-count metric, so दृश्य is defensible rather than a count mistranslation.
Current-period plural source VALUES intentionally differ from key; Hindi matches values, so no correction is needed merely to match the key.
All privacy, deletion irreversibility, guest/recoverable-account distinctions and numeric bounds were read; no additional specific defect identified.

Native glossary is Swarm building=छत्ता, colony=बस्ती, workers=श्रमिक, warriors=योद्धा, explorers=खोजी, credits=क्रेडिट, reserved=आरक्षित. Five online building references need alignment; literal swarm API/model identifiers remain unchanged.
limitations: No in-app rendered context, native-human certification or full-locale signoff is claimed.
Full online rendering, accessibility and platform checks remain separate acceptance gates; this is linguistic review, not locale finalization.
